links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-4 versus critical care physicians against blinded chart-review ground truth
links.effect: Accuracy 88.3% for physicians vs 85.0% for ChatGPT-4, no significant difference (McNemar p=0.249); Cohen's kappa agreement 0.57 (95% CI 0.35-0.79)
links.quote: The diagnostic accuracy was 88.3% for physicians and 85.0% for ChatGPT-4, with no significant difference by McNemar testing (p-value of 0.249).

screen.reason: Retrospective case study evaluating the diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-4 using redacted H&P notes compared to physician diagnoses, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
